references.text: The same boundary description for Judah, which also mentions the Valley of Hinnom's son and the Jebusite slope
Mentions the Valley of Rephaim and En-Rogel in the same geographical context for Judah's border
The Valley of Rephaim is mentioned as the place where the Philistines gathered against David
The Valley of Rephaim is referred to as a battlefield where David fought against the Philistines
En-Rogel is mentioned as the place where Jonathan and Ahimaaz waited for news
The Valley of Hinnom's son is referred to as Topheth, where children were sacrificed to Molech
King Ahaz burned incense in the Valley of Hinnom's son and had his sons pass through the fire
King Manasseh had his sons pass through the fire in the Valley of Hinnom's son
Jebus (Jerusalem) is mentioned as one of the cities in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin
